verdict: ROAS is strong at 5.36x, but purchase volume needs attention now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads generated $8,009.23 in revenue from 39 purchases on $1,494.11 in spend — a 5.36x return. That efficiency number actually improved 31.6% week-over-week, which means the spend that is working is working well. The concern is volume: purchases dropped 50% week-over-week while spend was only trimmed 7%, pointing to a conversion issue rather than a budget one. We're actively reviewing the ad creative and audience targeting to diagnose why purchase days are going dark mid-week. Expect a clearer picture next week as those adjustments take effect alongside conversion tracking improvements currently in progress.
